profile.summary: Devereux Advanced Behavioral Health Georgia is part of Devereux, a national nonprofit behavioral health organization. The Georgia location offers residential treatment for youth with emotional, behavioral and developmental challenges, specialty foster care, and educational services. It has operated in Cobb County, Georgia since 1973.
